scenario.title: 「她跟我說…」轉述別人的話
scenario.context: 八卦的本質就是轉述：「她說她要離職」「他跟我說他們分手了」。英文轉述別人的話時，時態通常要往過去退一格，代名詞也要跟著換，這是「間接引述」。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: OK, I have to spill the tea. Did you hear about Tony?
lines.zh: 好，我一定要說這個八卦。你有聽說 Tony 的事嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: He told me he was leaving the company next month.
lines.zh: 他跟我說他下個月要離職。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What? He said he loved it here!
lines.zh: 什麼？他之前說他很喜歡這裡！

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I know. He said he had gotten an offer from a startup in Singapore.
lines.zh: 我知道。他說他拿到新加坡一家新創的 offer。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Wow, that's juicy. Does Karen know?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Word on the street is she found out yesterday.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I heard they're hiring someone new already.
lines.zh: 嗯，別說是我講的，但我聽說他們已經在找新人了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did Leo say anything about Saturday?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yeah, he said he couldn't make it because his mom was visiting.
lines.zh: 有，他說他不能來，因為他媽媽要來。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Oh, too bad. Did he tell you when she's leaving?
lines.zh: 喔，可惜。他有說他媽媽什麼時候走嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: He said she would stay until Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did he dish about his new girlfriend, too?
lines.zh: 他有爆料他新女友的事嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ha, no. He told me it was none of my business.
lines.zh: 哈，沒有。他跟我說那不關我的事。

patterns.note: 轉述聽來的消息時最常用的字

patterns.en: You didn't hear it from me.
I'm not sure if it's true, but ___.
patterns.zh: 我不確定是不是真的，但 ___。

chinglish.wrong: He said me he is leaving.
chinglish.right: He told me he was leaving. / He said he was leaving.
chinglish.why: 兩個錯：say 不能直接接人（複習第 20 單元）；轉述時時態通常要往過去退。
轉述時 will 要退成 would。中文「她說她會來」的「會」沒有時態，所以容易忘。

chinglish.wrong: I listened that they broke up.
chinglish.right: I heard that they broke up.

chinglish.why: 文法沒錯，但 keep it between us 是更自然的慣用說法。

grammar.title: 間接引述 I：say / tell＋時態後退
grammar.oneLiner: 轉述別人過去說的話時，時態通常往過去退一格：is → was、will → would、has → had。
whenToUse: 現在式 → 過去式："I'm leaving." → He said he was leaving.
現在完成 / 過去式 → 過去完成："I got an offer." → He said he had gotten an offer.
will → would，can → could："I'll stay till Tuesday." → She said she would stay…
代名詞和時間詞要跟著換：I → he，tomorrow → the next day，here → there。
tell + 人 + (that)…；say + (that)… / say to + 人。
如果內容現在仍然成立，口語可以不後退：He said he loves it here.（到現在還是喜歡）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文轉述只要加「他說」，後面的句子原封不動：「他說他要離職」。英文的 said 是過去式，後面的內容也要跟著往過去退，時間線才一致。台灣人最常見的錯是 He said he will…，雖然母語者也聽得懂，但不夠精確，在正式寫作中會被當成錯誤。

examples.note: 口語中若到現在仍成立可以不退，但一般要退。

examples.correct: He told me he would call later.
examples.incorrect: He told me he will call later.

examples.correct: They said they had already booked the tickets.
She told me she couldn't come.
He said he loves his new job.
examples.note: 現在仍然成立的事，口語可以不後退。

quiz.question: "I'm moving to Tokyo." → She said she ___ to Tokyo.
"I'll text you." → He said he ___ text me.
"I can't come." → She said she ___ come.
Which is correct?
options: He said me he was busy.
He told me he was busy.

slang.usage: tea = 八卦內容（源自美國黑人及 drag 文化的 T = truth）。Spill the tea! = 快說！

risk.note: 網路和年輕人用語，工作場合避免；語氣玩笑。

examples.en: Come on, spill the tea! What happened at the party?
examples.zh: 快說快說！派對上發生什麼事？

examples.en: She always spills the tea about celebrities.

slang.usage: 形容有趣又刺激的消息：juicy gossip / juicy details。

examples.en: Ooh, that's juicy. Tell me more!
I want all the juicy details.

slang.usage: Word on the street is (that)… = 大家都在傳…

examples.en: Word on the street is they're getting married.
What's the word on the street about the new manager?

slang.usage: dish about someone / dish the dirt = 說某人的八卦。

risk.note: 帶「講別人閒話」的意味，別在當事人面前用。

examples.en: Come over and dish! I want to hear everything.
examples.zh: 過來爆料！我全部都要聽。

examples.en: She loves to dish the dirt on her exes.

review.question: You worked a double shift? You ___ be exhausted.
review.explanation: 複習第 35 單元：must 表強烈推測。

review.question: I prefer texting ___ calling.
review.explanation: 複習第 34 單元：prefer A to B。

review.question: By the time I heard the news, everyone else ___ already heard it.
review.explanation: 複習第 32 單元：過去完成式。

review.question: I ___ lunch when Amy told me the news.
review.explanation: 複習第 28 單元：背景用過去進行式。

review.question: She ___ me a secret.
review.explanation: 複習第 20 單元：tell + 人。

review.question: We ___ (see) Leo with his new girlfriend yesterday.
